discovery_notes: Fresh central list covered all recent activity and every live/nonterminal lane, including older idle, waiting and blocked lanes. Scanned 327 recent/running projections plus 1,421 older live projections, with no additional domain candidates in the older set. Recent detailed-history reads succeeded for 291 agents after seven smaller-read recoveries. Thirty-six detail reads remained unavailable and are not represented as successful reads.

Authorized search covered 66,286 saved messages in nine daily batches across three cells. The fourth cell rejected tenant-unattributed saved history; no raw shared index, identity override or authorization workaround was used.

All 86 PM projects and 554 updated tasks across 31 projects were scanned, together with 48 CLI catalog projects and 133 Git common-directory stores across dev, Jeff and FSN. Cloned repositories can repeat commits across hosts.

Fresh Namecheap read-only snapshot has 78 records and 74 A/AAAA/CNAME names. All match monitored or retired dispositions. Fourteen recent DNS-engineering/control artifacts and live nginx ingress on main/dev/storage were checked. Jeff and FSN have no nginx or active caddy/listening HTTP edge.

Screens is an active test service on the dev host. Release notes enroll only an Azure test VM and leave production activation pending. Its GET /health is anonymous, side-effect-free JSON. Monitoring never opens support sessions, enrolls devices or requests screen/control access.

New ignored candidates are historical aliases, mail/research/vendor references, crawler sources, fixtures, encoded text and ephemeral tunnels. The three DePlanbook aliases, old Azure DFT origins and historical CIS/Potaito names are currently NXDOMAIN. Legacy stable.skybuyfly.com fails certificate hostname validation; canonical PitchAI endpoints are already normally monitored.
